name: Kato
source:
The de-facto leader of the Northmanni though many don’t even know he exists. Very cynical and is only interested in fighting strong foes. Scrupulously careful about his style of fighting.

[spoiler] A Huge siscon. Dotes on Kairi even though he regularly deletes himself from her memory. [/spoiler]
